_comment: EventBridge Scheduler, not EventBridge Rules and not cron on a box. The reason is ScheduleExpressionTimezone: Scheduler resolves NZDT/NZST itself, so 03:00 NZ means 03:00 NZ all year. Every other option here needs the two-cron daylight-saving hack the GitHub workflow carried, where each pair fires twice a year at the wrong hour and one of them has to be discarded by a guard inside the job.

schedules.Name: auxein-surfaces-daily
schedules.Description: Fit D-2 daily surfaces. D+2 not D+1: ECAN_AIR lands ~24.8 h behind and is 10 thermometers in the largest temperature deficit region.

EcsParameters._comment_network: RDS auxein-db is PubliclyAccessible in vpc-03a13bd8504825dd9, so a public-subnet task with a public IP reaches it without NAT. The task's security group must be added to the RDS security group's inbound rules.

RetryPolicy._comment: One retry. The job is idempotent — S3 objects overwrite and the index upserts — but a second failure is a real fault and should be seen, not buried under retries.

schedules.Name: auxein-surfaces-refit
schedules.Description: Weekly re-fit of D-9..D-3. daily_aggregation revises weather_data_daily for ~3 days after the fact; without this the surface and the DB disagree permanently and invisibly.
